title: Confirmatory corpus freeze
description: Objective: freeze implementation, mechanically audit namespaces/constants/gates, then seal the confirmatory BENCH corpus and comparator manifests without developer exposure. Deliverable: signed corpus/configuration manifests and preregistration record. NOT in scope: changing implementation after freeze or running claims early. Hard dependencies: every implementation/release gate and Benchmark telemetry harness. Owned paths: restricted benchmark corpus/manifests and campaign configuration only. Verification: benchmark mechanical pre-freeze audit.
definitionOfDone: Implementation commit, design/benchmark hashes, constants, gates, comparators, model matching, and hardware are frozen and printed.
Corpus is sealed only after the commit freeze and developers do not receive confirmatory contents.
Any later implementation change invalidates the campaign mechanically.
Pre-freeze audit reports zero unresolved namespace, constant, gate, or reference errors.
taskRails: Claims follow the benchmark permit-list; missing, partial, cross-basis, or unverifiable evidence is UNKNOWN, never PASS.
No confirmatory corpus is generated or viewed until the implementation commit is frozen exactly as specified.
GO_QUIESCE and GO_ACTIVATE are separate human decisions. Keep evidence exact, reproducible, and scoped to one source commit.
